== Shared dataset acceptance checklist
For each mesh level, retain the generator or immutable download, license/access conditions, units, physical markers, cell/node/DoF counts, SHA-256 digest and partition recipe. Published reference counts do not establish availability of those meshes.
No new campaign is required to accept the scientific description. Planned items must retain their status until the corresponding files or run records exist.

== Checks after revision
All 14 source fiches have been re-read against the application inventory. FDA readiness and untraceable mesh counts were corrected; NLCRB now follows the implemented Galerkin/regression method; the forward, inverse and control scopes are separated. The PDF pages and internal/report links were checked after regeneration. Case-owner decisions below remain open; absence of new code or results alone is not a scientific-fiche blocker.
